title: Tax Payment Payment Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tax:payment payment_usd=*
| stats sum(payment_usd) as total_value, avg(payment_usd) as avg_value by payment_method
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks payment method values by total and average payment amount across tax payment events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `payment_usd` values for each tax payment event and review total and average payment amount by payment method.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total payment amount.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which payment method shows the biggest payment amount numbers in your tax payment data.
